definitions.gloss: price tag; for-sale sign; sale ticket
definitions.explanation: A tag or sign attached to goods indicating the price or indicating that the item is for sale. Can also refer to a ticket sold for an event or transportation.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}に{売札|うりふだ}がついている。
examples.english: The product has a price tag on it.

examples.japanese: {売札|うりふだ}の{値段|ねだん}を{確認|かくにん}してから{買|か}った。
examples.english: I checked the price on the tag before buying.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{家具|かぐ}に{売札|うりふだ}が{貼|は}られて、{骨董市|こっとういち}に{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: Old furniture with price tags attached was lined up at the antique market.

notes:
Composed of {売|う}り (selling) and {札|ふだ} (tag, label, card). A somewhat traditional or literary word. In modern everyday speech, {値札|ねふだ} (price tag) is more commonly used for the price label on merchandise. {売札|うりふだ} retains a slightly old-fashioned flavor and is more likely to appear in formal or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売札|うりふだ}をつける: to attach a price tag
- {売札|うりふだ}を{貼|は}る: to stick on a for-sale sign
- {売札|うりふだ}の{金額|きんがく}: the amount on the price tag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {値札|ねふだ}: price tag — the standard modern term for price labels on goods
- {正札|しょうふだ}: list price tag — the official marked price
- {荷札|にふだ}: luggage tag, shipping label — a tag for identifying packages or baggage
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag — a tag showing a person's name
